parameters.formDescription:
Fetch, summarize and deliver newsletters to Telegram.
Leave dates blank for yesterday → today (1-day digest).

values.fieldLabel: Author (partial match — leave as 'All' for everyone)
values.placeholder: e.g. Lenny   or leave as All

parameters.body:
={{ JSON.stringify({model:"gpt-4.1",temperature:0,response_format:{type:"json_object"},messages:[{role:"system",content:"You are a newsletter summarizer. Your only job is to compress newsletters into structured summaries.

RULES:
1. Summarize ONLY what is explicitly stated in the newsletter. Do NOT add facts from your training data.
2. If uncertain whether a claim is from the newsletter or your own knowledge, omit it.
3. If newsletter contradicts itself, include bullet: 'Note: conflicting statement about [topic].'
4. Surface the author's primary argument faithfully.

OUTPUT FORMAT - return valid JSON only, no markdown:
{"category":"<Emerging Tech|Product Principles and Building|PM Interview Prep|Personal Finance|Other>","author_name":"<newsletter author or brand>","date":"<date from email header>","summary_bullets":["<bullet 1>","<bullet 2>","<bullet 3>"],"worth_reading_in_full":true_or_false,"reading_reason":"<one sentence or empty string>","substack_or_web_link":"<best available web link — check in this order: (1) any View-in-browser / Read-online / Read-this-email link at the TOP of the email, (2) Substack / Beehiiv / Ghost read-online link in footer, (3) any canonical article URL in footer. Prefer a direct article URL over the newsletter homepage. Empty string only if no web link exists at all."}

CATEGORIES:
- Emerging Tech: AI, LLMs, developer tools, new platforms
- Product Principles and Building: product strategy, PMF, PM craft
- PM Interview Prep: interview frameworks, case studies, job search
- Personal Finance: investing, savings, income strategy
- Other: does not clearly fit above

QUALITY: 3-5 bullets, each = one distinct self-contained insight. If promotional only: summary_bullets:["No substantive content."]"},{role:"user",content:"From: "+($json.From||"")+"
Subject: "+($json.Subject||"")+"
Date: "+(new Date(parseInt($json.internalDate||'0')).toLocaleDateString('en-US',{year:'numeric',month:'long',day:'numeric'}))+"
Category hint: "+($json.category_hint||"none")+"

"+($json.clean_body||$json.snippet||"")}]}) }}

parameters.content:
## ⚠️ One-time setup required

**Replace `SHEET_ID_HERE`** in 3 nodes:
- Read Newsletter Config
- Read Summaries Log
- Log to Google Sheets

Get your Sheet ID from the URL:
`https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/**ID**/edit`

Sheet needs 2 tabs:
**Newsletter Config** (cols: sender_query, display_name, category_hint, active)
**Summaries Log** (cols: Gmail Message ID, Date, Category, Author, Subject, Summary, Link)

## Triggers
**Telegram:** Send `/summarize` to @Abhinav\_digest\_bot
With dates: `/summarize 2026-04-01 2026-05-01`
Default: yesterday only

**n8n UI:** Click Execute Workflow

## Batch Loop
One sender at a time from config sheet.
Fetches Gmail → deduplicates → strips HTML → GPT-4.1 summary.

**Loop-back:** Parse Response reconnects to Split In Batches.
